points.description: States that as time increases, the size of the ice cube decreases (it gets smaller / melts over time). Equivalent wording accepted; must link both variables and the correct direction (inverse relationship), in a sentence.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only one variable's change is described (e.g. 'the ice cube melts') without linking to time.

levels.says: Only says the ice cube gets smaller/melts, without referring to time, or mentions both variables without the direction clearly stated.

rubric.notes: Full mark for a sentence saying the ice cube's size decreases as time increases (equivalent wording accepted). Half for saying it shrinks/melts without linking to time. No marks for wrong direction, e.g. size increases.
